configurePresets.name: capture-x86
configurePresets.displayName: capture-x86: the 32-bit capture DLL patcap.dll for Tibia.exe, nothing else (MSVC x86; issue #94)
configurePresets.description: Needs MSVC for x86 set up (vcvarsall.bat x86): python -I tools/build.py capture-x86 does it. Builds build/capture-x86/Release/patcap.dll (cmake/Capture.cmake), which the reference recordings' record step and the live comparisons load into Tibia.exe; no client, no tests.

configurePresets.name: windows-x64
configurePresets.displayName: windows-x64: the Windows product (MSVC x64, SDL3): the client and the unit tests
configurePresets.description: Needs MSVC for x64 set up (vcvarsall.bat x64): python -I tools/build.py windows-x64 does it. Needs Tibia.exe in the root (or PATELLA_TIBIA_EXE) for the client's resources, and Python; PATELLA_CLIENT=OFF builds only the unit tests; without Tibia.exe PATELLA_PLACEHOLDER_RESOURCES=ON builds the client with neutral pictures (the hosted CI's build).

configurePresets.name: windows-x64-asan
configurePresets.displayName: windows-x64-asan: windows-x64 with MSVC's AddressSanitizer (/fsanitize=address): the client, the test build, golden_runner and the unit tests (issue #70)
configurePresets.description: As windows-x64 (python -I tools/build.py windows-x64-asan sets up MSVC x64; Tibia.exe for the client's resources, PATELLA_CLIENT=OFF for only the unit tests and golden_runner). Debug without /RTC1 and every link without /INCREMENTAL, which ASan does not allow. Needs Visual Studio's C++ AddressSanitizer component.

configurePresets.name: windows-x64-gcc
configurePresets.displayName: windows-x64-gcc: mingw-w64 GCC 16, C++26 on Windows (plan D6); so far the unit tests (issue #9)
configurePresets.description: Needs mingw-w64 GCC 16 (gcc, g++) on PATH.

configurePresets.name: linux-x64-gcc
configurePresets.displayName: linux-x64-gcc: GCC 16 on Linux x64: the Linux client (Patella, PatellaTest; issue #131), patella_core and the unit tests (issue #7)
configurePresets.description: Needs GCC 16 (gcc, g++) on PATH and SDL3's X11/Wayland build dependencies; the Docker image of docker/linux-x64 has them. On Windows: python -I tools/build.py linux-x64-gcc runs it in that image, with the local Tibia.exe's cursors (mounted read-only). PATELLA_CLIENT=OFF: only the unit tests; PATELLA_PLACEHOLDER_RESOURCES=ON: neutral pictures, the hosted CI's build.

configurePresets.name: linux-x64-clang
configurePresets.displayName: linux-x64-clang: Clang on Linux x64 with AddressSanitizer and UBSan: the Linux client (issue #131), patella_core and the unit tests (issue #7)
configurePresets.description: Needs Clang (clang, clang++) with compiler-rt on PATH, using GCC 16's libstdc++ (issue #121); the Docker image of docker/linux-x64 has Clang 22 with it. On Windows: python -I tools/build.py linux-x64-clang runs it in that image.
